aluminium can [5f0c25].source: Aluminium 2700 kg/m³. The wall is only about 0.1 mm and a full can's drink soaks up the impact, so it lands with a thud: e 0.25, friction 0.3 provisional.

foam [0b2933].source: Flexible polyurethane foam 24-40 kg/m³ (Engineering ToolBox). It soaks up an impact: bounce and friction provisional.

steel weight.source: Weights are made to a conventional density of 8000 kg/m³ (OIML R 111); steel on wood friction about 0.4. A big flat block lands dead: bounce provisional.

varnished hardwood [2df08a].source: Density: hardwood 600-800 kg/m³. Bounce chosen so a superball on it gives Cross's measured 0.86.

dark wood [54be8f].source: Dark hardwood (walnut, mahogany) 650-800 kg/m³; a wooden ball on a wood floor rebounds with e about 0.62 (provisional).

golf ionomer [569967].source: USGA/R&A: at least 42.67 mm, at most 45.93 g; surlyn cover. e about 0.78 against a rigid plate at 140 ft/s, a little higher when slow: 0.80 is provisional.

felt (tennis) [dcdfdb].source: ITF: 65.4-68.6 mm, 56.0-59.4 g; 254 cm onto concrete rebounds 135-147 cm, so e = 0.745. Friction, rolling, side provisional.

PVC (beach ball) [2bb882].source: Inflatable PVC film 0.15-0.3 mm, about 100 g at 40 cm (provisional); soft, low pressure, so a dull bounce (provisional).

aluminium [395245].source: Aluminium 2700 kg/m³. Friction on wood and bounce provisional.
